title: 第23章 大风起留字临渊第24章 小镇外乘鹭遨游
slug: 我在大虞当杀手那些年
content_zh:
“杀了他！”
锦衣公子一声令下，侍卫们早已饥渴难耐了的大刀，朝着裴礼砍了下去。
噗噗噗！！
七八个侍卫脖子好似被利器切割，头颅高高飞起，鲜血犹如泉水，喷涌而出。
红红的灯笼上，被鲜血飞溅。
红灯笼，与血的颜色，是那般相似，可却没了喜庆的氛围。
裴礼手持竹竿，以竹竿作剑，剑气好似犹如实质。
谯楼上，
剩余的侍卫们好似嗜血的野兽，举着明晃晃的刀刃，朝着瞎子悍不畏死的冲来。
唰！
是风的声音。
裴礼的速度极快，远处的侍卫也看到一道残影一闪而逝。
砰砰砰！！
侍卫们手中的刀断成两节，齐齐掉在地上。
紧接着，静止不动的侍卫，脑袋从脖子上滑落，脖子上残留的剑气，连鲜血都无法突破。
“去死吧！”
侍卫长看准时机，挥舞一杆长枪捅了出来。
噗！
一根竹竿刺进他的嘴里，竹竿从其脑后捅了出来。
裴礼抽出竹竿，侍卫长一头栽倒。

“吕先生，如何？”
林天武看了眼身旁的老者。
老者面色凝重道：“未出全力，看不出深浅。”
林天武皱了皱眉，对裴礼道：“我的侍女是无辜的，让她们走。”
裴礼没有说话。
林天武一个眼神，那些吓得战战兢兢的侍女，立刻往谯楼的出口跑去。
裴礼任由她们从自己身旁离开。
某一瞬，脑袋一偏，躲过一刀。
裴礼抓住那只纤细的手腕，微微发力，直接捏碎了骨头。
“啊！”
侍女发出凄厉的哀嚎，紧接着咽喉就被一只大手抓住。
“何苦来哉。”
裴礼一声叹息，捏断了这名侍女的脖子。
“杀！！”
其他侍女捡起地上的刀剑，朝着裴礼刺来。
嗖嗖嗖！
几根飞针划破空气，正中眉心。
近二十名侍女身子一软，倒在了血泊中。
那几名世家子弟还想趁乱逃跑，不过裴礼一并解决了。
都是些毒瘤，早些切除，危害还能少点。

谯楼上，
裴礼站在一地尸体当中，尸体几乎铺满了地面，鲜血汇聚在一起，沿着楼梯，缓缓流淌。
起风了。
content_en:
"Kill him!"
Young Master Jinyi gave an order, and the guards slashed at Pei Li with their swords, which were already hungry and thirsty.
Puff puff puff! !
The necks of seven or eight guards seemed to have been cut with sharp weapons, their heads flew high, and blood gushed out like spring water.
The red lantern was spattered with blood.
The red lanterns were so similar to the color of blood, but they lacked the festive atmosphere.
Pei Li held a bamboo pole and used the bamboo pole as a sword. The sword energy seemed to be the substance.
On the Qiao Tower,
The remaining guards were like bloodthirsty beasts, holding up gleaming blades and rushing toward the blind man without fear of death.
Uh-huh!
It's the sound of the wind.
Pei Li's speed was extremely fast, and the guards in the distance also saw an afterimage flashing away.
Bang bang bang! !
The knives in the hands of the guards were broken into two pieces and fell to the ground.
Immediately afterwards, the still guard's head slipped from his neck, and even the blood could not break through the remaining sword energy on his neck.
"Go to hell!"
The captain of the guard saw the right moment, brandished a spear and thrust it out.
puff!
A bamboo pole was thrust into his mouth and the bamboo pole came out from the back of his head.
Pei Li pulled out the bamboo pole and the captain of the guard fell down.
"Mr. Lu, how are you?"
Lin Tianwu glanced at the old man beside him.
The old man looked solemn and said: "I haven't exerted my full strength, so I can't tell the depth."
Lin Tianwu frowned and said to Pei Li: "My maids are innocent, let them go."
Pei Li said nothing.
With a look from Lin Tianwu, the maids who were trembling with fear immediately ran towards the exit of Qiao Tower.
Pei Li let them leave him.
At a certain moment, his head tilted and he avoided a knife attack.
Pei Li grabbed the slender wrist, exerted a slight force, and crushed the bone directly.
"Ah!"
The maid let out a shrill wail, and then her throat was grabbed by a big hand.
"Why bother?"
Pei Li sighed and broke the maid's neck.
"Kill!!"
The other maids picked up the swords on the ground and stabbed Pei Li.
Whoosh whoosh!
Several flying needles pierced the air and hit the center of the eyebrow.
Nearly twenty maids went limp and fell into a pool of blood.
The children of the aristocratic families also wanted to take advantage of the chaos to escape, but Pei Li dealt with them all.
They are all cancerous tumors. If they are removed early, the harm will be less.
On the Qiao Tower,
Pei Li stood among the corpses. The corpses almost covered the ground. The blood gathered together and slowly flowed along the stairs.
The wind picked up.
